properties.name: Vertex Tower
properties.note: Brand-new supertall with its own Cyan stop in the Seaport loop, between Seaport and City Point. Name nods to Vertex Pharmaceuticals at Fan Pier; the tower is ours. Placed by hand between the two stations

properties.name: TD Garden
properties.note: Event service: extra Orange, Green and Cyan trains for Garden events (line posters)

properties.name: Fenway Park
properties.note: Event service: extra Green and Yellow trains for Fenway events (line posters)

properties.name: Encore Boston Harbor
properties.note: Casino with its own Cyan stop and Mystic River dock; event boats and trains (Cyan poster, ferry notice)

properties.name: Stadium site
properties.note: Proposed stadium at the old Mystic power plant, Everett: its own Stadium stop on Cyan and Yellow, a Mystic dock, event trains and boats. Seats: City of Everett 25,000, ENR 24,000 (sources differ). Not approved

properties.name: Hatch Memorial Shell
properties.note: Event dock on the Charles River (ferry passenger notice)

properties.name: Agganis Arena
properties.note: Event dock on the Charles River (ferry passenger notice)

properties.name: Leader Bank Pavilion
properties.note: Event dock 'Pavilion' on the Seaport boat (ferry passenger notice)

properties.name: Suffolk Downs
properties.note: Point is the Blue Line station (Nominatim); the redevelopment surrounds it. Wikipedia's coordinates are rounded and sit 1 km off. Redevelopment drawn as a larger Blue Line station, with ferry landings. Homes: HYM 10,000, Boston Planning 2020 about 7,000 (sources differ)

properties.name: Long Island Recovery Campus
properties.note: Mayor Wu's recovery campus plan (permits 2025); a Harbor Islands ferry stop is ours

properties.name: Dorchester Bay City (Columbia Point)
properties.note: Real development on the old Bayside Expo site (master plan approved September 2023, per research/tram-route-assessment.md); docs/IDEAS.md names it as a development-led stop
